newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Tele-Network begins trade on ASE.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Tele-Network begins trade on ASE.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said it began trading the common stock of Atlantic Tele-Network Inc, the holding company for Virgin Islands Telephone Corporation and Guyana Telephone and Telegraph Company Ltd.
Atlantic Tele-Network operates its subsidiaries and other telecommunications businesses from its headquarters in the U.S. Virgin Islands.

Trading under the ticker symbol ANK, the stock opened at 11-1/2 on 3,100 shares. Kalb, Voorhis & Co./HYY Securities has been selected as the specialist unit for the new listing. Atlantic Tele-Network formerly traded on the Nasdaq National Market.
